editProfile.title: Edit Profile
editProfile.nameHint: {{length}}/40 · Shown on your profile and leaderboards
editProfile.achievementsEmpty: Add up to 4 career highlights — e.g. PBs, podiums, titles.
editProfile.coverHint: Tap to add a cover photo

photo.cameraBody: Please allow camera access in Settings to take a photo.
photo.libraryBody: Please allow photo library access in Settings to choose a photo.
photo.libraryBodyShort: Please allow photo library access in Settings.

gallerySheet.removeBody: Delete this photo from your gallery?

error.required: Please enter a new email address.
error.same: That is already your email address.

oauth.title: {{provider}} account
oauth.body: Your POWR account is linked to {{provider}}. To change your email, update it in your {{provider}} account first, then sign in to POWR again.

pending.title: Check both inboxes
pending.sentTo: We sent a confirmation link to:
pending.hint: Click both links to complete the change. Until then, keep signing in with your old email. If you ignore the emails, nothing changes.

changeEmail.headline:
Change
<gold>email.</gold>
changeEmail.intro: For your security we'll email a confirmation link to both your current and new addresses. Both must be clicked to complete the change.

error.tooShort: New password must be at least 6 characters.
error.same: New password must be different from your current one.

success.title: Password updated
success.body: Your password has been changed successfully.

resetSent.title: Check your inbox
resetSent.body:
We sent a reset link to
<email>{{email}}</email>
resetSent.hint: Click the link in the email to set a new password, then log back in.

google.title: Google account
google.body: Your account uses Google Sign-In. To change your password, manage it through your Google account settings.

partial.title: One more step
partial.hintWithEmail: We also sent a link to <email>{{email}}</email>. Click that one too to finish moving your POWR account.
partial.hintNoEmail: We also sent a link to your other inbox. Click that one too to finish moving your POWR account.

done.title: Email updated
done.body:
Your POWR account is now signed in as
<email>{{email}}</email>
done.hint: Use this address next time you sign in.
done.notYou: If this wasn't you, contact support@powr.life right away.

invite.title: Invite a friend
invite.body: Share your POWR ID — you both earn 20 POWR

error.invalidCode: We don't recognise that code. Check the 8 characters against your friend's message — letters and numbers only, no I or O.
error.selfReferral: That's your own POWR ID — share it with a friend instead.
error.alreadyReferred: An invite code is already applied to this account.
error.windowClosed: Invite codes can only be added in your first couple of weeks, and that window has closed.
error.notAuthenticated: Please sign in again to apply your code.
error.network: Couldn't reach POWR. Check your connection and try again.
error.nothingToPaste: Nothing that looks like a code on your clipboard.
error.wrongLength: An invite code is 8 characters long.

applied.title: Code applied
applied.body: You and {{name}} both earn 20 POWR once you log your first verified workout. Time to move.

referred.title: You were invited
referred.body: {{name}} invited you to POWR. You both earn 20 POWR once you log your first verified workout.

closed.title: That window has closed
closed.body: Invite codes can only be added in your first couple of weeks. Your own POWR ID still works for inviting friends — find it in Settings › Account.

inviteCode.headline:
Invite
<gold>code.</gold>
inviteCode.intro: Joined on a friend's invite but never entered their code? Add it here and you'll both earn 20 POWR after your first verified workout.
inviteCode.daysLeft_one: {{count}} day left to add one — a code can't be applied after that.
inviteCode.daysLeft_other: {{count}} days left to add one — a code can't be applied after that.
inviteCode.lastDay: Last day to add one — a code can't be applied after that.
inviteCode.footnote: A POWR ID is 8 characters — your friend can find theirs in Settings › Account, or in any invite they send you.
